body:
Now that the EMC tour is over (I’m still feeling pretty sad about that … it was such an enjoyable experience) … people have been asking about when I’ll be doing some international travel. Here’s what’s planned this year and next:

2008

Africa: Rwanda, Burundi – May 19-28

England, RUN conference – June 17-19

England, Lambeth – July 19-23

Canada (Calgary) – August 20

England – Greenbelt – August 22-25

Scotland, England – December 5-10

2009

Nicaragua – January 17-22

Costa Rica – January 23-31

South Africa – May 4-12

Ireland – July 3-7

Australia – October 2-5 (Sydney), 7-8 (Brisbane)

We may be adding a few other trips in 2009 … and of course, specifics remain tentative, and we’ll include details later on. Just fyi –
